How many orders did each customer place?
results.expected_sql: SELECT customers.name, COUNT(orders.order_id) FROM customers JOIN orders ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id GROUP BY customers.name;
results.actual_sql:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders 
FROM customers c 
LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id 
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name;

results.question: Which customer placed the most orders?
results.expected_sql: SELECT customers.name, COUNT(orders.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers JOIN orders ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id GROUP BY customers.name ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1;
results.actual_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY COUNT(o.order_id) DESC LIMIT 1;

results.question: Show total revenue per customer.
results.expected_sql: SELECT customers.name, SUM(orders.order_amount) FROM customers JOIN orders ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id GROUP BY customers.name;
results.actual_sql:
SELECT c.customer_id, SUM(o.order_amount) AS total_revenue 
FROM customers c 
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id 
GROUP BY c.customer_id;

results.question: List customers who have placed orders.
results.expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT customers.name FROM customers JOIN orders ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id;
results.actual_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id;

results.question: Show top 5 customers by total spend.
results.expected_sql: SELECT customers.name, SUM(orders.order_amount) AS total FROM customers JOIN orders ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id GROUP BY customers.name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5;
results.actual_sql:
SELECT c.name, SUM(o.order_amount) AS total_spend 
FROM customers c 
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id 
GROUP BY c.name 
ORDER BY total_spend DESC 
LIMIT 5;

results.question: How many orders were placed last month?

results.actual_sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id) FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) = strftime('%Y-%m', date('now','-1 month'));
